title: On Pursuing the thief across three fields
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：pursue　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pursue 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the warden ① pursued the thief across three fields before dawn, and every resident in the centre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the warden ② pursues the thief across three fields in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ pursue the thief across three fields at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ pursued the thief across three fields before — a line in the register for June 1986 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Pursuing the thief across three fields before dawn, the warden said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the notice at the far gate, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ pursue the same trade for twenty years in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Pursue the same trade for twenty years at once and never mention it again.

By 1999 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the register, and a new resident from the next centre ⑧ pursues the same trade for twenty years before dawn every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the gate, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ pursued the thief across three fields again when nobody else would.

⑩ To pursue the thief across three fields, my mother said in 2004, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the centre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the centre forgets, somebody pursues the thief across three fields in public again and somebody must pursue the thief across three fields before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 追赶（一般过去式 pursued the thief across three fields：1992 年管理员头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 追赶（一般现在 pursues the thief across three fields：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 追赶（不定式 to pursue the thief across three fields：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 追赶（过去完成时 had pursued the thief across three fields：1986 年六月的登记册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 追赶（动名词 pursuing the thief across three fields 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 从事（pursue the same trade for twenty years：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去从事同一门手艺做了二十年）
G. v. 从事（pursue the same trade for twenty years：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 追赶（后段两处：新来的居民照例 pursues the same trade for twenty years，而母亲又一次 pursued the thief across three fields）

answers.why: pursue 意为“追赶”，1992 年管理员天没亮就追赶越过三块地追那个贼，那是社区中心里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 pursued。
pursue 意为“追赶”，自那以后管理员当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 pursues。
pursue 意为“追赶”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯追赶越过三块地追那个贼”，此处为不定式 to pursue the thief across three fields。
pursue 意为“追赶”，登记册里 六月 那行字说明早在 1999 年之前就有人追赶过，故用过去完成时 had pursued。
pursue 意为“追赶”，管理员说“追赶越过三块地追那个贼这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 pursuing the thief across three fields 作主语。
pursue 意为“从事”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去从事同一门手艺做了二十年”，should ever 之后用原形 pursue the same trade for twenty years。
pursue 意为“从事”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻从事同一门手艺做了二十年（pursue the same trade for twenty years at once），以后再也不要提起。
pursue 意为“追赶”，新来的居民每个月份都照例从事同一门手艺做了二十年，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 pursues。
pursue 意为“追赶”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就追赶越过三块地追那个贼，用一般过去式 pursued 叙述。
pursue 意为“追赶”，结尾那句是母亲 2004 年的话：要追赶越过三块地追那个贼，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和社区中心记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 pursue 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1992 the warden pursued the thief across three fields before dawn, and nobody in the centre forgot it.
Even now the warden pursues the thief across three fields in public whenever the centre asks.
Pursuing the thief across three fields before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever pursue the same trade for twenty years in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new resident from the next centre pursues the same trade for twenty years before dawn every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother pursued the thief across three fields again, and the centre remembered that half.
